name: Mac Davis
abstract_title: Gene therapy as the ultimate entheogen: Klotho gene therapy clinical trial results and experiential case reports
abstract: Klotho is a cognition enhancing hormone secreted by the choroid plexus which modulates fluid intelligence, synaptic plasticity, NMDA receptor folding, neuroinflammation, and broadly suppresses brain aging. Klotho was discovered by Makoto Kuro-o in a laboratory accident and was found to extend mouse lifespan repeatably by 30-40%. notable: Investments from Sam Altman and Peter Thiel; first person to receive plasmid Klotho gene therapy
notes: Entrepreneur and biohacker, not traditional academic.
